accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Cyprinus carpio, scaled common carp visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. Scaled gold-brown common carp, not mirror or leather carp. USGS overview simplifies visible barbels; the FAO diagnostic specifies two pairs, including the short upper-lip pair, used here.
